summary_ko: 가장 짧은 새 방향성 관측 경로는 CF4 거리모듈러스의 깊이·각도 반응과 같은 호스트 방법차의 공통 보정인자를 한 상태에서 결합하는 것이다. 같은 호스트 차는 기하를 지우지만 CF4와 실제로 공유되는 방법차 보정인자를 제한할 수 있다. 핵심 판별기는 결합 설계의 영공간과 깊이에 따른 dipole 반응이다. 현재 원본은 이 연결에 필요한 경험적 선택법칙·공분산·보정 전이 자료를 제공하지 않으므로 새 실자료 신뢰영역은 아직 없다. CF4 기존 채널 c 격리, BASS 비의존성, 공통 nuisance 단일 tuple을 유지한다.

source_bound_findings.claim: CF4 original distance/redshift product is available in typed source semantics, but its reconstruction columns cannot become a true-flow sampling vector.
source_bound_findings.details: table3 has DMzp, DMav and method-specific moduli, uncertainties/counts and coordinates. table4 has DMzp/e_DMzp/Dist, Vh, V3k and reconstructions Vpds/Vpwf/Vpec. V3k is frame-derived; fV3k cosmology-corrected; SGX/SGY/SGZ are cz units. Select one documented original distance variable, declared redshift frame and stable 1PGC order. Do not consume both combined DMav and its constituent method measurements as independent data.

source_bound_findings.claim: The existing nine-column CF4 affine adapter is a conditional radial velocity experiment with fixed distances; it cannot justify a distance-modulus sampling law.
source_bound_findings.details: Requires Cf4OperatorInputs, full covariance in original group order, selected IDs, KNOWN_GAUSSIAN_CONDITIONAL and fixed distances/directions. Theta=(trace/3,Bx,By,Bz,Sxx,Syy,Sxy,Sxz,Syz); jacobian_eta is empty. Quoted distance errors neither supply this conditional covariance nor license conditioning on noisy distance without modeling its effect.

source_bound_findings.claim: Same-host geometry cancellation and shared measurement covariance are explicit in the JWST adapter.
source_bound_findings.details: Builds source_y, source design, host incidence H and transform T. Contrast mode y=T source_y, D=T design, V=T C T^T; T H=0. In the source fixture transform design=[0,1] and variance .04, using source covariance [[.04,.02],[.02,.04]]. Host Normal population cancels in contrasts. Student measurement scale is not variance; absolute mode convolves Normal host population with Student measurement through Gamma precision quadrature.

source_bound_findings.claim: The current adapters do not themselves connect CF4 and JWST to one shared physical/calibration tuple.
source_bound_findings.details: Both affine CF4 and JWST expose their fitted linear coefficients as theta with empty jacobian_eta. A new explicit global parameter embedding is required; coincident parameter names, a copied calibration source ID, or separate nuisance fitting is insufficient. outer_region expects the same ordered estimand and compatible tuple. Product-specific responses must first map to that tuple.

source_bound_findings.claim: Existing CF4 selected latent adapter is a useful exact specification skeleton, not a supplied empirical law or scalable full-catalogue integrator.
source_bound_findings.details: Requires intensity, normalized joint measurement density, selection probability, finite integration domains, fixed selected block/count and shared eta. Numerical nquad over joint observations and latent variables is only plausible for small blocks. It does not justify factorizing correlated groups or supply a Poisson count law. QUADPACK error estimates are operational rather than certified bounds. The unbound factory lacks its distance provider.

source_bound_findings.claim: Existing native qiso and Union3 scenario routes can remain useful controls while the new directional path is built.
source_bound_findings.details: qiso is conditional on the released fixed Gaussian scalar law and positive-qiso domain; it lacks angular response. Union3 preserves the published precision quadratic, fits flat-LCDM shape with one free common offset and has no exact-law budget or angular information. Neither by itself identifies directional/global tilt. Raw DESI requires exact selection, matched randoms and a normalized law; all mocks are refitted by build_desi_law.

source_bound_findings.claim: CF4 legacy channel c stays blocked independently of the new-method research branch.
source_bound_findings.details: OPEN findings C1-K5-MV-F1, C3-K5-VCORR-ML-F1 and N-DATA-CF4-DOWNSTREAM retain no numerical or replacement payload. Implicit channel sets and explicit c are refused. The new product must receive a distinct observation/method scope based on original rows and must not be presented as adjudication of or replacement for these findings.

derived_model.purpose: Concrete first-order low-redshift phenomenology for a new original-distance-variable branch, with actual calibration and selection response. This is not a Bianchi solution or newly asserted empirical law.
derived_model.conventions: metric (-,+,+,+); c retained in w=c z for an explicitly justified low-z redshift convention; w and B km/s, r Mpc, H and S km/s/Mpc, mu and calibration offsets mag; n is the observer-to-source unit direction in one fixed declared frame.
derived_model.general_model: mu_ij = 25 + 5 log10(d_L(z_i,n_i;theta)/Mpc) + g_ij^T eta + x_ij^T kappa + b_ij + epsilon_ij. eta is the same physical calibration tuple across every participating product. kappa includes product-specific nuisance with explicit sharing maps; b belongs to a fixed discrepancy set. No Gaussian epsilon law is inferred from a quoted e_DM column.
local_derivation: Postulate the local affine recession field v(x)=B+(H I+S+Omega)x for the bounded low-z phenomenological candidate, with S symmetric trace-free and Omega antisymmetric; x=r n.
Radial data have w=n^T v=n^T B+r(H+n^T S n), since n^T Omega n=0.

If w-n^T B>0 and H+n^T S n>0, r=(w-n^T B)/(H+n^T S n). Using d_L approximately r is a further low-z approximation; finite-redshift distance corrections must be supplied or bounded before product admission.
At baseline B=0,S=0,H=H0, set K=5/ln(10), u=n^T B/w, q=(deltaH+n^T S n)/H0. Then mu-mu0=K[ln(1-u)-ln(1+q)]+g^T eta+x^T kappa+b_cosmo.
Linearized responses are partial_Ba mu=-K n_a/w, partial_Sa mu=-K n^T E_a n/H0, partial_H mu=-K/H0. Here E_a is the explicitly declared five-component STF matrix basis, not an implicit normalization.

For source distance D=10^((mu-25)/5) Mpc, changing the calibration zero point changes inferred distance multiplicatively; a Gaussian law in mu does not become Gaussian in D or in peculiar velocity by relabeling.

response_discriminators.pattern: Dipole n_a/w in modulus residuals; decays with depth at this order
response_discriminators.test: Freeze multiple depth bins and evaluate residualized singular values under the same method/selection design; compare mirror signs and orientations. A single shell can be exactly collinear with a sky dipole calibration term.

response_discriminators.pattern: Quadrupole n^T E_a n, depth-independent at this leading approximation
response_discriminators.test: Preserve absolute sky frame and verify angular design spans the tested STF combinations. Axial-only or incomplete sky directions may fail to identify off-diagonal components.

response_discriminators.pattern: Common modulus offset at first order and an exact scale degeneracy with an unrestricted common calibration shift
response_discriminators.test: Report scale-free directional functionals or supply an actual non-canceling absolute anchor. Same-host contrasts cannot establish H0.

response_discriminators.pattern: Source-defined incidence, metallicity, crowding, zero-point and method effects where supported by source metadata
response_discriminators.test: Same-host contrast rows constrain only differences that survive T. Transfer to CF4 requires the same calibrator graph and physically justified coefficients, not sky proximity.

response_discriminators.pattern: Can produce depth-, sky- and method-dependent residual means
response_discriminators.test: Inject the actual selected sampling process, or predeclare defensible nuisance/discrepancy bounds; method counts alone cannot predict this mean.

derived_model.frame_warning: V3k already uses a CMB-frame transformation. A proposed local observer beta=v/c cannot be independently added to these rows without forwarding the original frame conversion and distinguishing source bulk B from observer velocity. Matter-congruence tilt and its derivatives remain separate physical variables.

linearization_remainder.formula: For |u|<=rho_u<1 and |q|<=rho_q<1, |R_mu| <= K/2 [u^2/(1-rho_u)+q^2/(1-rho_q)] <= K/2 [rho_u^2/(1-rho_u)+rho_q^2/(1-rho_q)]. Add an independently justified |b_cosmo(z)| bound and other model errors.
linearization_remainder.proof: The Taylor remainder of ln(1+x) has absolute series bound sum_{k>=2}|x|^k/k <= x^2/[2(1-rho)] on |x|<=rho<1.
linearization_remainder.consumer: Feed this rowwise magnitude box, with any justified correlations retained, to the R9 deterministic model-discrepancy set before nuisance projection and confidence inversion. Domain positivity and the finite-redshift remainder are part of the response contract.
linearization_remainder.unresolved: No source-bound cosmographic/selection error bound for actual CF4 rows was supplied. The algebraic log remainder alone does not make the response empirically accurate.

equations: Original same-host rows: d_J=H_host mu_host+G_J eta+epsilon_J. A contrast T obeying T H_host=0 gives y_J=T d_J=(T G_J)eta+T epsilon_J, V_J=T C_J T^T.
Distance block: y_C=A_C theta+G_C eta+X_C kappa+b_C+epsilon_C. Calibration block: y_J=0*theta+J eta+X_J kappa+b_J+epsilon_J, with J=T G_J.

Local structural target L theta is identifiable on an unrestricted linear domain iff every (delta_theta,delta_eta,delta_kappa) in ker([[A_C,G_C,X_C],[0,J,X_J]]) obeys L delta_theta=0. With bounds, evaluate feasible fibres rather than claiming full-rank identification.

The contrasts help a CF4-confounded target exactly when they rule out its calibration compensation: A_C delta_theta+G_C delta_eta+X_C delta_kappa=0 cannot coexist with J delta_eta+X_J delta_kappa=0 for a target-changing direction.

Under known joint covariance and a fixed Gaussian selected law, whiten the stacked law and compute this criterion by nuisance projection. If cross-product covariance is unknown, use source-qualified marginal block regions at fixed alpha with the same unprofiled tuple, then project their intersection; do not use a block-diagonal covariance by default.
calibration_bridge.absolute_scale_counterexample: If eta0 is a common additive calibration zero point, r changes under H -> H exp(t), eta0 -> eta0+K t with mu invariant in the isotropic low-z model. Same-host T1=0 leaves this degeneracy intact. A method-difference calibration is not an absolute anchor.
calibration_bridge.shared_tuple_counterexample: Toy y_C=theta+eta+e_C and y_J=eta+e_J. Both scalar means at the one common eta give theta interval y_C-y_J +/- z*(sigma_C+sigma_J) under two Bonferroni marginal bands. Profiling eta independently in each block first yields all theta; replacing eta by independent eta_C,eta_J likewise removes the gain.
calibration_bridge.monotonic_information_condition: For a declared independent known-Gaussian toy with nuisance information E>0 and calibrator information G>=0, existing calibration_information_gain computes I_old=U-V E^-1 V^T and I_new=U-V(E+G)^-1 V^T. This conditional Schur-complement statement is not permission to assume empirical cross-product independence.

interpretation: At rho=0 the common true tuple has observed coverage .9522, CP99 [.9481803,.9560028]; the exact two-block union-bound argument supplies the >=.95 claim, not a Monte Carlo lower bound.
Projected theta intervals overcover, especially at positive correlation, because the unknown-dependence-safe rectangle projection is conservative. These are not empirical CF4/JWST widths.

One-shell dipole response is collinear with a sky-dipole nuisance (residual norm about 3.14e-16); adding a second normalized depth shell leaves residual norm .5 and augments rank. Actual survey windows/method maps may alter or remove this gain.

 return [0. if k==0 else float(beta.ppf(.005,k,n-k+1)),1. if k==n else float(beta.ppf(.995,k+1,n-k))]
out={'seed':20260912,'trials_per_cell':n,'toy_units':'dimensionless whitened variables','alpha_total':alpha,'alpha_each':alpha/2,'z':float(z),'cells':[]}
